cushion-halo-ring.html:
Cool and bright, built around one clear centre. An 8mm round brilliant clear cubic zirconia sits in four claws at the heart of a cushion shaped pave halo of about 12mm, with pave running down both shoulders and a plain polished shank behind. The metal is rhodium plated over surgical stainless steel, so the setting reads cool rather than warm. It adjusts to fit US 5 to 8, and works as an everyday statement or a proposal style ring.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with cool toned studs and a bare second hand for a balanced look.

Details

  • Size: Adjustable, fits US 5 to 8
  • Stone: Round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, approximately 8mm, four claw set
  • Halo: Cushion shaped pave halo, approximately 12mm across
  • Band: Pave set down both shoulders, plain polished shank behind
  • Plating: Rhodium plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

rose-verdant-band.html:
Four fine lines, warmed to rose. This open ring is built from four parallel bands, each one pave set with clear stones across the front of the finger and left plain around the back, with four round emerald green cubic zirconia of about 4mm placed at staggered points. The metal is rose gold plated rather than solid rose gold, and the stones are green cubic zirconia rather than emerald. With an open back that adjusts a little in fit, it wears well on its own or beside a plain band.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with rose gold tone studs so the warm finish carries through the look.

Details

  • Size: Inner diameter approximately 16.5mm (US 6) at rest, the open back eases a little larger
  • Band: Open ring with four fine parallel bands, all four pave set across the front and plain around the back
  • Stone: Four round emerald green cubic zirconia, approximately 4mm each, at staggered points
  • Stone note: Green cubic zirconia, not emerald
  • Fit: Open back allows a small amount of adjustment
  • Plating: Rose gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

granule-dome-ring.html:
A surface you notice, and nothing competing with it. The dome on this open ring measures about 16.8mm long and 15.7mm wide, its whole face covered in fine raised gold granulation, bead upon bead, with no stones at all. A heavy tapered shank carries it, and the open back adjusts a little around US size 7. Wear it alone on the index finger where the texture gets room to read.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the rest of the hand bare so the dome texture reads clearly.

Details

  • Size: Open back, adjustable, fits about US 7
  • Weight: 4.5g
  • Dome: Approximately 16.8mm long and 15.7mm wide
  • Surface: Fine raised gold granulation
  • Surface detail: Solid gold granulation throughout, no stones
  • Band: Heavy tapered shank with an open back, adjustable around US 7
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

verdant-eternity-band.html:
Green and clear, alternating all the way round. Oval emerald green cubic zirconia of about 5mm by 4mm are claw set around the band, each cradled by a scalloped pave setting of small clear stones. The metal is rhodium plated over surgical stainless steel, and the open back adjusts between US 6 and 8. Wear it for a festive evening, or as a colour break in a stack of plain bands.

STYLING TIP: Layer it with plain cool toned bands so the green stones stand out between them.

halo-curve-ring.html:
Two stones that do not match, and that is the point. This solid gold tone band of about 17mm inner diameter carries a natural tiger eye beside a faceted pale champagne crystal, each held in its own irregular bezel shaped to follow the stone rather than correct it. The tiger eye is opaque, banded brown and gold, with a soft moving sheen across it; the crystal beside it is clear and cut. The weight sits solidly across the finger. Wear it on its own, with the rest of the hand kept bare.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the index finger with bare hands so the two stones stay the whole story.

Details

  • Size: Inner diameter approximately 17mm, about US 6½
  • Weight: 4g
  • Band: Solid gold tone band, inner diameter approximately 17mm, metal approximately 1.5mm
  • Stone one: Natural tiger eye, opaque with chatoyant banding, approximately 11.8mm
  • Stone two: Faceted pale champagne crystal
  • Setting: Irregular bezels shaped to each stone
  • Style: Statement cocktail ring
  • Plating: 18k PVD gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

The metal is rhodium plated over surgical stainless steel, and the open back gives a little room in the fit. Wear it as the only ring on the hand.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with bare nails and no other rings so the dome stands alone.

petite-pave-band.html:
Four lines, crossing at a single point. This open ring runs four fine parallel bands across the finger, two of them pave set with a continuous line of small round clear cubic zirconia and two left plain polished gold, with the pave strands crossing over the plain ones at the front. One slightly larger clear cubic zirconia sits in four claws at the crossing. It adjusts between US 6 and 8, so the fit stays forgiving.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a plain band on the next finger so the crossing stays legible.

It opens between the ball and the drop, so it adjusts to fit. In warm gold or bright silver tone; pairs with the Droplet Open Cuff.

No stones, no seams to catch, just a lot of light from one shape. Wear it alone or stacked with a slim band.

Wear one ring on each of two fingers and let the chain fall between them.

STYLING TIP: Wear the stone-set band on the middle finger and the slim band on the ring finger, so the chain sits in the gap between them.
